# Kaghan Properties

> Kaghan Properties is a premier real estate advisory, property management, and turnkey construction company based in Islamabad, Pakistan, serving local and overseas Pakistani investors across Islamabad, Rawalpindi, and the Kaghan/Galyat Alpine region.

## Core Information
- **Company Name**: Kaghan Properties
- **Founder & CEO**: Tanzil Minhas (MCS)
- **Headquarters**: Office 203, 2nd Floor, Asian Arcade, opposite Zoo, C Avenue, Sector C, Bahria Enclave, Islamabad, Pakistan
- **Alpine Hub**: Kaghan Valley & Nathia Gali, Pakistan
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +92 334 0091127 / +92 334 0091127
- **Official Website**: https://kaghanproperties.com
- **Email**: info@kaghanproperties.com / tanzilminhas@kaghanproperties.com

## Main Services
- **Turnkey Villa Construction**: Architectural design, structural grey structure, luxury finishes, smart home automation, and handover in Bahria Enclave, DHA, and CDA Sectors.
- **Short-Term Rental & Airbnb Management**: 360-degree hospitality management for serviced apartments and vacation chalets with guaranteed 8.5% to 11% annual yields.
- **Real Estate Brokerage & Advisory**: Verified buying, selling, and leasing of residential houses, luxury apartments, commercial plots, and penthouses.
- **Overseas Pakistani Concierge**: Digital legal documentation, Special Power of Attorney (SPA) processing, property tax compliance, and remote investment portfolio oversight.

## Primary Investment Territories
- **Bahria Enclave Islamabad**: Sector A, Sector C (Azan Arcade), Sector G, luxury apartments, and residential villas.
- **DHA Islamabad / Rawalpindi**: Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 4, and DHA Valley.
- **CDA Sectors**: G-11, F-10, E-11, B-17 Multi-Gardens, and Park View City.
- **Kaghan Valley & Nathia Gali**: Alpine suites, boutique hotel apartments, and holiday chalets.
